      (function () {
        try {
          var path = document.location.hash.split('?')[0].split('/');
          var domain = path[1];

          var NOT_DOMAINS = ['new-project', 'sign-in', 'facebook', 'sign-out', 'sign-up', 'email-login'];

          if (domain === undefined || domain.length === 0 || path.length !== 2 || NOT_DOMAINS.includes(domain)) {

          }

        } catch (e) {
          console.error(e);
        }
      })();

          alt="" moz-do-not-send="true" width="256" vspace="4"
          hspace="12" height="362" border="4" align="left">Hello. This
        is the readme.md file for <a moz-do-not-send="true"
          href="https://satansunderpantsmc.glitch.me/">SATANS UNDERPANTS
          MOTORCYCLE CLUB</a><br>
        <p>SATAN'S UNDERPANTS M.C. is a link portal. The links are
          checked regularly so the site is functional at all times. The
          links listed are generally WAREZ RELATED SUCH AS TORRENT SITES
          AND THE ODD WAREZ LINK TO SPECIALIST REPOSITORIES SUCH AS
          AUDIOWAREZ, GRAPHICS WAREZ, ANIMATION WAREZ PLUS MOVIES, TV
          SHOWS, CARTOON STREAMERS ETC.<br>
          There's a bunch of interesting sites just for fun as well<br>
          We home you can start your day here<br>
        </p>
        Thanks to Glitch.me for hosting our little heaven.<br>
